params.name: groupId
params.description: The artifact group ID.  Must be a string provided by the client, representing the name of the grouping of artifacts. Must follow the ".{1,512}" pattern.

params.name: artifactId
params.description: The artifact ID.  Can be a string (client-provided) or UUID (server-generated), representing the unique artifact identifier. Must follow the ".{1,512}" pattern.

params.name: offset
params.description: The number of branches to skip before starting to collect the result set.  Defaults to 0.

params.name: limit
params.description: The number of branches to return.  Defaults to 20.

items.docs:
Returns a list of all branches in the artifact. Each branch is a list of version identifiers,
ordered from the latest (tip of the branch) to the oldest.

This operation can fail for the following reasons:

* No artifact with this `groupId` and `artifactId` exists (HTTP error `404`)
* A server error occurred (HTTP error `500`)

items.docs:
Creates a new branch for the artifact.  A new branch consists of metadata and a
list of versions.

This operation can fail for the following reasons:

* No artifact with this `groupId` and `artifactId` exists (HTTP error `404`)
* A branch with the given `branchId` already exists (HTTP error `409`)
* A server error occurred (HTTP error `500`)

Add a new version to an artifact branch. Branch is created if it does not exist. Returns a list of version identifiers in the artifact branch, ordered from the latest (tip of the branch) to the oldest.
This operation can fail for the following reasons:
* No artifact with this `groupId` and `artifactId` exists (HTTP error `404`)
* No branch with this `branchId` exists (HTTP error `404`)
* A server error occurred (HTTP error `500`)
